parts:
Hi all,

I've set up a wiki for ggplot2 at http://ggplot2.wik.is/ - it's pretty
empty at the moment, but I hope in time that it will become a useful
resource for the community.

To get the ball rolling, please enter the ggplot2 case study competition -
http://ggplot2.wik.is/Case_study_competition.  All you need to do to
enter is create a wiki page that shows of a ggplot2 plot you found
useful for better understand your data.  Be in to win a free book of
your choice from Springer's useR series!  (two free books generously
donated by Springer)

Hadley
